answer: Time-locked staking stops capital recycling: each identity stakes 120 units for 20 epochs, and proven fraud slashes 60% and resets the lock. A forge-proof credential binds the stake to one key, so the same funds cannot back two identities, and a terrace of penalties doubles each repeat freeze. The violet cost curve: 1,000 fakes lock 120,000 units, and with 30% caught the attacker loses 21,600 units, while honest agents get their stake back.
